verdict.rationale: Docs show payout speed settings, merchant pricing templates, and dispute management, implying some money-tracking infrastructure, but there is no explicit documentation of per-seller balance views, platform fee account tracking, or charge-to-split-to-payout traceability/reconciliation. Missing for 10: explicit balance-by-seller/fee-account reporting, transaction-level traceability from charge through split to payout, and reconciliation tooling or statements.
